content.text:
I added the `/` shortcut. Enter-to-add and Escape-to-cancel already worked, so I only tagged that code. I didn't run the app or any tests. I checked the earlier features by reading the code, and nothing looks broken.

- **`/`** now jumps to the search box. It doesn't fire while you type in a text field, date, dropdown or the edit box, or with Ctrl, Cmd or Alt held. When a checkbox or button has focus, it still jumps. Any text already in the search box gets selected.
- **Enter** in the todo input submits the form, which adds the todo.
- **Escape** in an inline edit puts the old text back. Blur is guarded, so cancelling doesn't save the edit by mistake.

I read each earlier feature against the rules: add, delete, toggle, due dates (DEC-005), priority order (DEC-008/009/010), completed items last (DEC-003), search without trimming (DEC-012), blank edits (DEC-011), filters and bulk actions. The code follows all of them. I found nothing to fix.

There are no standing checks. The app is one inline script with no separate functions to test, so I didn't add one. REQ-008 (the bug report) is still open. It couldn't be reproduced earlier, and nothing here changes that.
